title: Character Prompt Builder Prompt Vocabulary
description: A categorized vocabulary resource for agent-selected image-prompt construction.

single_valued.description: Authored guidance that this category usually describes one value for one figure. The author assesses multiple terms in their subject and scope context.

multiple_figures_terms.description: Terms the dictionary associates with multiple figures. This evidence informs the author's interpretation of subject scope.

close_scale_terms.description: Terms in this category that put the subject close enough for a fragile part to occupy many pixels.

opposes.description: Terms the dictionary records as opposing this entry in a shared scope. The author evaluates their actual subjects, regions, time and intended relationship.

fragile_at_close_scale.description: Authored evidence of possible difficulty at close scale, retained for the author's model-specific review.

part.description: The subject part this term describes, retained as evidence for the author's scope and visibility review.

hides.description: Parts the dictionary associates with occlusion under this term. The author evaluates actual visibility in the intended image.

usage_notes.description: Meaning or usage caveats presented beside this term during request preparation. The author decides its intended meaning.
